description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team The Tech PMO sits at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Tech Strategy. Our mission is to bring structure, visibility, and scalable operating systems to how Grab Tech plans and executes its technology investments - enabling leadership to make clearer, data-driven decisions as we scale. Get to Know the Role We're hiring a Senior Program Manager who operates and automates how Grab Tech plans, governs, and gains visibility into its technology investments. You'll own real operational outcomes - tech budgeting, vendor governance, portfolio visibility…
